content.text: Is any thing too hard for the Lord, Gen. 18:14. the Lord is in this place; and I knew it not, Gen. 28:16. Lord God of the Hebrews hath met with us, Ex. 3:18. ye shall know that I am the Lord, Ex. 6:7. there is none like unto the Lord, Ex. 8:10. the earth is the Lord’s, Ex. 9:29. Who is like unto thee, O Lord, among the gods, Ex. 15:11. I know that the Lord is greater than all gods, Ex. 18:11. Who is on the Lord’s side, Ex. 32:26. Lord spake unto Moses face to face, Ex. 33:11. I the Lord your God am holy, Lev. 19:2. Lord bless thee, and keep thee, Num. 6:24. know that the Lord he is God, Deut. 4:35. O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord, Deut. 6:4 (Mark 12:29). thou shalt love the Lord thy God, Deut. 6:5 (Matt. 22:37; Mark 12:30). Lord your God is God of gods, Deut. 10:17. Lord came from Sinai … with ten thousands of saints, Deut. 33:2. Lord God of Israel was their inheritance, Josh. 13:33. as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord, Josh. 24:15. they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, Judg. 2:12. Lord is a God of knowledge, 1 Sam. 2:3. Lord: let him do what seemeth him good, 1 Sam. 3:18. he is the Lord’s anointed, 1 Sam. 24:10. Lord is my rock, and my fortress, 2 Sam. 22:2 (Ps. 18:2). who is God, save the Lord, 2 Sam. 22:32 (Ps. 18:31). if the Lord be God, follow him, 1 Kgs. 18:21. Lord passed by … Lord was not in the wind, 1 Kgs. 19:11. Give unto the Lord the glory, 1 Chr. 16:29 (Ps. 96:8). O Lord our Lord, how excellent is thy name, Ps. 8:1 (8:9). Lord is King for ever and ever, Ps. 10:16. I have set the Lord always before me, Ps. 16:8 (Acts 2:25). Lord is my shepherd, Ps. 23:1. Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle, Ps. 24:8. Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, Ps. 33:12. O taste and see that the Lord is good, Ps. 34:8. Lord … cometh to judge the earth, Ps. 96:13. Lord is merciful and gracious, Ps. 103:8. Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Ps. 110:1 (Matt. 22:44; Mark 12:36; Luke 20:42; Acts 2:34). Lord is high above all nations, Ps. 113:4. This is the Lord’s doing, Ps. 118:23 (Matt. 21:42; Mark 12:11). Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain, Ps. 127:1. I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, Isa. 6:1 (2 Ne. 16:1). Lord Jehovah is my strength, Isa. 12:2 (2 Ne. 22:2). Trust ye in the Lord for ever, Isa. 26:4. I am the Lord: that is my name, Isa. 42:8. I, am the Lord; and beside me there is no saviour, Isa. 43:11. One shall say, I am the Lord’s, Isa. 44:5. I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, Isa. 60:16. Lord is the true God, he is the living God, Jer. 10:10. he shall be called, The Lord Our Righteousness, Jer. 23:6. Know the Lord: for they shall all know me, Jer. 31:34 (Heb. 8:11). your God is … a Lord of kings, Dan. 2:47. Lord cometh forth out of his place, Micah 1:3. Lord is slow to anger, and great in power, Nahum 1:3.

Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, Matt. 4:10 (Luke 4:8). Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, Matt. 7:21 (3 Ne. 14:21). Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, Matt. 9:38 (Luke 10:2). Father, Lord of heaven and earth, Matt. 11:25 (Luke 10:21). Lord even of the sabbath day, Matt. 12:8 (Mark 2:28; Luke 6:5). ye know not what hour your Lord doth come, Matt. 24:42 (JS—M 1:46). see the place where the Lord lay, Matt. 28:6. how great things the Lord hath done for thee, Mark 5:19. Lord working with them, and confirming the word, Mark 16:20. Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord, Luke 1:46. a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord, Luke 2:11. why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not, Luke 6:46. Lord is risen … and hath appeared to Simon, Luke 24:34. Lord, to whom shall we go, John 6:68. Ye call me Master and Lord, John 13:13. taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, John 20:2. Thomas … said unto him, My Lord and my God, John 20:28. whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ, Acts 2:36. Lord added to the church daily, Acts 2:47. Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, Acts 9:5 (22:8; 26:15). Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands, Acts 17:24. seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, Acts 17:27. same Lord over all is rich unto all, Rom. 10:12. put ye on the Lord, Rom. 13:14. he might be Lord both of the dead and living, Rom. 14:9. there is … one Lord Jesus Christ, 1 Cor. 8:6. this is not to eat the Lord’s supper, 1 Cor. 11:20. no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost, 1 Cor. 12:3. second man is the Lord from heaven, 1 Cor. 15:47. One Lord, one faith, one baptism, Eph. 4:5. should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, Philip. 2:11. do all in the name of the Lord, Col. 3:17. coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints, 1 Thes. 3:13 (Jude 1:14). Lord himself shall descend from heaven, 1 Thes. 4:16. Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, 2 Thes. 3:3. Lord knoweth them that are his, 2 Tim. 2:19. Lord, the righteous judge, 2 Tim. 4:8. boldly say, The Lord is my helper, Heb. 13:6. If the Lord will, we shall live, James 4:15. ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious, 1 Pet. 2:3. unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ, 2 Pet. 1:8. heresies, even denying the Lord, 2 Pet. 2:1 (Jude 1:4). Lord is not slack concerning his promise, 2 Pet. 3:9. Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints, Jude 1:14. Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come, Rev. 4:8. he is Lord of lords, Rev. 17:14 (19:16).

I will go and do the things which the Lord hath commanded, 1 Ne. 3:7. forgotten that the Lord is able to do all things, 1 Ne. 7:12. own due time of the Lord, they should return, 1 Ne. 10:3 (14:26; D&C 68:14). course of the Lord is one eternal round, 1 Ne. 10:19. Have ye inquired of the Lord, 1 Ne. 15:8. led, the Lord their God, their Redeemer, going before, 1 Ne. 17:30. Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, should manifest himself unto them in the flesh, 2 Ne. 6:9. with righteousness shall the Lord God judge the poor, 2 Ne. 30:9. Lord God will consecrate my prayers, 2 Ne. 33:4. Lord of the vineyard saw that his fruit was good, Jacob 5:75 (5:8–75; D&C 103:21). repentance and faith on the Lord Jesus, Mosiah 3:12. salvation … through the name of Christ, the Lord Omnipotent, Mosiah 3:17 (3:5). Lord had created all men, and had also redeemed, Alma 1:4. Lord God ordained priests, after his holy order, Alma 13:1. Lord God, the God of Abraham … did deliver them out of bondage, Alma 29:11. Lord God sent our first parents forth from the garden of Eden, Alma 42:2. Lord God placed cherubim and the flaming sword, Alma 42:3. nothing can save this people save it be repentance and faith on the Lord, Hel. 13:6. voice of the Lord came unto him, 3 Ne. 1:12. Lord spake unto them, 3 Ne. 11:13. voice of the Lord came unto me, Morm. 3:14. Lord stretched forth his hand and touched the stones, Ether 3:6.

life and light of the world, your Redeemer, your Lord, D&C 10:70. listen to the words of Jesus Christ, your Lord, D&C 15:1. I, Jesus Christ, your Lord … have spoken it unto you, D&C 17:9 (95:17). I am … Christ the Lord, D&C 19:1. one thousand eight hundred and thirty years since the coming of our Lord, D&C 20:1. I come quickly. I am your Lord, D&C 34:12. Listen to the voice of the Lord, D&C 35:1. I, the Lord, who was crucified for the sins of the world, D&C 53:2. thus saith … the Lord of the whole earth, D&C 55:1. seek the face of the Lord always, D&C 101:38. Lord God of Israel, who keepest covenant, D&C 109:1. We saw the Lord standing upon the breastwork, D&C 110:2. Lord … shall stand in the midst of his people, D&C 133:25. Lord shall be red in his apparel, D&C 133:48.
Abraham, talked with the Lord, face to face, Abr. 3:11. coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord, JS—H 1:38. first principles … first, Faith in the Lord Jesus Christ, A of F 1:4.
